user.title: OpenESL access point
user.description: The AP's address on your network and its API token (set on the AP's setup page).

data_description.host: The AP's name, `openesl-xxxx.local` on an AP set up after 0.6.0 (`openesl.local` before), or its IP address.
data_description.token: The token from the AP's setup page (`/setup`).

zeroconf_confirm.title: OpenESL access point found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Add the access point {name} at {host}? Its API token is on the AP's setup page.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token
reauth_confirm.description: The access point {name} no longer takes the token. Enter the one it has now.

error.cannot_connect: No answer from an OpenESL access point at that address.
error.invalid_host: Not a host name or IP address.
error.locked: The AP is refusing every request for 60 s after five wrong tokens. Wait a minute and try again.
error.wrong_ap: That address is another access point.

abort.already_configured: This access point is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the tags are read from the AP. The reply is about 600 bytes a tag, so with many tags or weak WiFi read less often. The tags themselves poll the AP every 60 s by default.

send.name: Send
send.description: Puts text on tags with a layout: the built-in `text` (4 lines) or `price`, or a layout in the AP's layout file. Only content that changed is drawn.

mac.name: MAC
mac.description: Tags by their 16-digit MAC instead (a tag the AP does not know yet gets it when it appears).

layout.name: Layout
layout.description: `text`, `price` or the name of a layout in the AP's layout file.

fields.name: Fields
fields.description: The text, in the layout's field order. All fields together take at most about 90 characters.

price_highlight.name: Highlight
price_highlight.description: White on black for the price (`price`) or the layout's highlight elements.

frame.name: Frame
frame.description: A black frame around the screen (`text`) or the layout's frame elements.

at.name: At
at.description: Show it from this time instead of now (the AP keeps it until then).

config_entry_id.name: Access point
config_entry_id.description: With more than one AP: the one a MAC it does not list yet goes to.

send_image.name: Send picture
send_image.description: Shows a PNG on tags. It must be the tag's screen size: 296 x 128 for the 2.9", 200 x 200 for the 1.54".

path.name: File
path.description: The PNG on the Home Assistant machine, in a folder in `allowlist_external_dirs` (or under /config/www).

dither.name: Dither
dither.description: Mix black and white for shades of grey (photos) instead of taking the nearest.

config_entry_id.name: Access point
config_entry_id.description: With more than one AP: the one a MAC it does not list yet goes to.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Reads the tags from the AP now instead of at the next minute.

not_loaded.message: No OpenESL access point is set up and running.

unknown_ap.message: That access point is not set up or not running.

which_ap.message: No access point lists the tag {mac} yet: choose which one under Access point.

failed_partly.message: It failed ({error}). The first {done} tags got the content before that.

auth.message: The access point no longer takes the API token.

cannot_connect.message: No answer from the access point: {error}

path_not_allowed.message: Home Assistant may not read {path}: add its folder to allowlist_external_dirs.
